title: What Happens If You Drive With Foggy Windows
hook: Never ignore foggy windows while driving.

script.narration: Never ignore foggy windows while driving.
script.visual_search: driver POV through foggy car windshield

script.narration: Moisture inside your cabin traps condensation on cold glass, blinding your peripheral vision. Turning on your air conditioner removes humidity instantly, clearing your view.
